svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint on AWS, from CloudFormation: 7 nodes, 6 connections. 7 resources on AWS, nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from CloudFormation. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-1axniuzgt21, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint on AWS, from CloudFormation
svg.desc: Parcelpoint on AWS, from CloudFormation: 7 nodes, 6 connections. 7 resources on AWS, nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from CloudFormation. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret. Nodes: - Account: AWS account - parcel-prod-api (API Gateway), gateway - parcel-prod-track (Lambda), function - parcel-prod-events (Lambda), function - parcel-prod-parcels (DynamoDB), database - parcel-prod-labels (S3 bucket), storage - parcel-prod-carrier-events (SQS queue), queue - parcel-prod-carrier-events-dlq (SQS queue), queue Connections: - parcel-prod-api to parcel-prod-track: GET /parcels/{id} - parcel-prod-track to parcel-prod-parcels (stored data line): data - parcel-prod-track to parcel-prod-labels (stored data line): storage - parcel-prod-events to parcel-prod-parcels (stored data line): data - parcel-prod-carrier-events to parcel-prod-carrier-events-dlq (asynchronous line): dead letters - parcel-prod-carrier-events to parcel-prod-events: triggers
